parts.text: During the strawberry harvest at Grandma Concetta's orchard, Tony is able to gather 6 quarts of strawberries every hour.
Bobby, on the other hand, collects one quart less every hour compared to Tony.

What is the total quantity of strawberries, in quarts, that Tony, Bobby, Ricky, and Kathy can collectively gather in an hour at Grandma Concetta's orchard?

parts.text: Jaime is a computer programmer for a company that currently has employed 1000 people.
Senior programmers are paid $4000 more than junior programmers.
